description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

New York Life is seeking an Associate Full-Stack Software Developer to help develop, enhance, and support modern cloud-based web applications. The role builds AWS backend services and React/TypeScript frontend applications, supports Varicent ICM integrations, and collaborates across the software development lifecycle to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.
Associate Full-Stack Software Developer building React/TypeScript web applications and AWS REST APIs, supporting Varicent ICM integrations

Responsibilities:
• Develop and enhance web application features across frontend and backend components under the guidance of senior developers and technical leads
• Build responsive, reusable, and maintainable frontend components using React, TypeScript, and Vite
• Develop and enhance backend services and REST APIs using AWS technologies such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3
• Support application functionality, configurations, data flows, and integrations involving the Varicent ICM platform
• Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices
• Develop unit tests and participate in integration, regression, and automated testing activities
• Troubleshoot application and integration issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work collaboratively to implement solutions
• Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and other Agile development activities
• Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, technical leads, product owners, and other technology partners throughout the software development lifecycle
• Follow established GitHub workflows, branching strategies, and CI/CD processes
• Work with AWS and container technologies such as EC2, ECR, Route 53, Docker, and related services as needed

Requirements:
• 1–2 years of professional software development experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field
• 1–2 years of professional software development experience, including relevant internship or co-op experience where applicable
• Hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web application development
• Experience or strong working knowledge of React, including components, hooks, state management, and REST API integration
• Experience with or working knowledge of the Varicent Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform, including Varicent configurations, data flows, integrations, and application functionality
• Familiarity with backend development, REST APIs, and AWS cloud services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3
• Experience with Git/GitHub, including source control, branching, pull requests, and collaborative development
• Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, debugging, unit testing, error handling, and secure coding practices
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Preferred:
• Experience with TypeScript and Vite for frontend application development
• Exposure to additional AWS services such as EC2, ECR, Route 53, IAM, and CloudWatch
• Familiarity with Docker, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines
• Experience with automated testing frameworks and frontend or API testing
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform
• Exposure to Python or another backend programming language
• Understanding of cloud security, application monitoring, logging, and observability
• Interest in cloud-native development, DevOps practices, automation, and emerging technologies such as Generative AI
